evidence: Table 3-3, printed p. 57: "the challenger's own 32L/4096H GQA (8 KV-heads × 128) = 0.131 MB/token at FP16 × 9,200 ≈ 1.20 GB". Earlier in §3.3.3, printed p. 45: "so 9,200 × 0.0655 MB ≈ 0.60 GB (≈1.2 GB at FP16)".
issue: The FP16 KV for the 32L/4096H GQA challenger is stated as ~1.20 GB in Table 3-3 but as ~1.2 GB in §3.3.3. Table 3-3's "≈ 1.20 GB" is a truncation; the prose's "≈1.2 GB" is a coarse rounding. Neither is the rounded value 1.21 GB. The 8-bit row has the same issue: 9,200 × 65,536 B = 602,931,200 B = 0.6029 GB, which the table prints as "≈ 0.60 GB" — also a truncation, not a rounding.
fix_instruction: In Table 3-3 and in §3.3.3, print the FP16 challenger KV as ~1.21 GB (1,205,862,400 B) and the 8-bit challenger KV as ~0.603 GB (602,931,200 B), or state explicitly that the 1.20 / 0.60 figures are truncations of the exact byte counts.
